# James M. Smith

> AI/Product Engineer at Magical in San Francisco. Ships production AI agents, LLM evals and full-stack products. B.S. Computer Science (Cybersecurity minor, Cum Laude) from Oregon State University, June 2026, while competing as an NCAA Division I athlete.

## Highlights

- Shipped 2 production AI agents at Magical that run daily on every customer automation: one reviews every workflow change and proposes patches; one fixes live failures autonomously, raising real-world accuracy to 95%. ([sheet](https://github.com/gitJamoo/brag-sheets/blob/main/experience/magical/brag.md))
- Proposed and led a switch to cheaper, better agent models with no regressions, saving an estimated $450K a year, enabled by an evals and benchmarking engine he rebuilt from scratch. ([sheet](https://github.com/gitJamoo/brag-sheets/blob/main/experience/magical/brag.md))
- As an AI Consultant, built a production AI quoting agent that saved each trader ~10 hours a month and moved $150K+ in revenue. ([sheet](https://github.com/gitJamoo/brag-sheets/blob/main/experience/independent-ai-consulting/brag.md))
- At The Estée Lauder Companies, worked on a recommendation chatbot projected at $1.5M in revenue across 12,000 live SKUs. ([sheet](https://github.com/gitJamoo/brag-sheets/blob/main/experience/estee-lauder/brag.md))

## Experience

- **Magical** (Jul 2026 – present): AI/Product Engineer, San Francisco. Production AI agents, evals and benchmarking, model selection, git-style versioning for workflows.
- **Independent** (May – Jul 2026): AI Consultant. Production AI quoting agent for a lumber manufacturer's sales desk (Claude via OpenRouter, N8N, SQL Server, Outlook).
- **BVR ST CO** (Oct 2025 – Jun 2026): Software Engineer. COORDINATOR, an AI system that learns football from game film (play recognition, NVIDIA Nemotron, LoRA).
- **Oregon State University, College of Business** (Aug 2025 – Jun 2026): AI Advisor. Enterprise AI adoption and the A2A agent registry that became OpenBeavs.
- **The Estée Lauder Companies** (Jun – Aug 2025): Machine Learning Intern, AI & Innovations.
- **Envolvly** (Feb 2023 – Jun 2026): Co-Founder. Creator-marketplace SaaS; won OSU's school-wide pitch competition.
- Earlier: NJ Transit (2024), Hats & Ladders (2022).

## Projects

- [EcoDues](https://ecodues.org): live, open-source SaaS that turns AI token usage into CO2e and monthly charity donations; built solo in about 10 days.
- [StuntCV](https://github.com/gitJamoo/stunt-cv): computer-vision analysis of cheerleading stunts (YOLOv8-pose, ByteTrack, FastAPI).
- [OVERSEER](https://overseer-website.vercel.app): desktop app using on-device computer vision for posture and focus, shipped with a paywall in 13 days (Tauri, Rust, React).
- [COORDINATOR](https://getcoordinator.ai/): BVR ST CO's agentic AI for real-time football strategy.
- [OpenBeavs](https://github.com/OpenBeavs): Oregon State's AI agent platform (senior capstone; largest contributor).
- [jcord](https://takehome-james-michael-smith.vercel.app/): real-time chat with voice and video, built in about a day.
- [j-m-s.dev](https://j-m-s.dev): this site, an AI-generated portfolio plus a 3D LLM sandbox.
